releaseRule: R17 reader may not become the production default until every blocker is closed and the authoritative v1.83 48-card LIVE map is certified.

protectedInvariants.detail: Card changes clear gesture, response, bell and cinematic transient state before the next cue owns the reader.

openBlockers.detail: Exact ordered v1.83 C01-C48 LIVE enumeration is still unrecovered. Eight of the ten historical v1.81 decompression splits are semantically recovered; exactly two remain area-only and unresolved: one Offertory boundary and one Canon boundary.
Final LIVE architecture must preserve v1.83 B021 Gradual ownership, separate B022 Alleluia/Tract Schola content, and B023 Munda cor meum start.
Schola remains a legacy temporary donor in native preview.
Native preview does not yet receive the approved icon-bank resolver from browser entry.
Cue-state projection is not yet certified across LOW and SOLEMN; unsupported forms must remain fail-closed/legacy.
Preceding rites, following actions, distinct rites and structural overlays are not yet native-reader certified.
Real-browser phone-width/touch acceptance for focus, first/last cue ownership, Back/Next, translations and card transitions has not yet been recreated for R17.
The quarantined 4 October Secret/Communion/Postcommunion fixture still requires accepted replacement witnesses.

Canonical bell events are structured in the Mass graph, but the native reader has not yet converged bell/cinematic projection. Card transitions must clear any bell/cinematic transient exactly as v1.83 required.

MC-COM-150 and MC-COM-160 are now independently suppressible and Pax Domini remains distinct, but MC-COM-160 still carries B/C_PENDING evidence. Accepted source authority and reader ownership for the Solemn ministerial Pax transfer must be pinned before release certification.

Plan-aware objective traversal now preserves the frozen graph while applying blessing/Last-Gospel and Pax-session deltas, but no non-test R17 runtime consumer owns that traversal yet. Native replacement must consume the planned traversal rather than raw buildObjectiveTraversal.
